entries.zh: 适时，正当其时（正行時）；好时机
entries.en: in good time, at the right moment; opportunely
entries.notes: M 栏“行”字声调污损（T99）；义取 a buen tiempo＝正行時

entries.zh: 好久，很长时间
entries.en: a long time, a good while

entries.zh: 悠久，长久
entries.en: long-lasting; of long standing

entries.zh: 时光，时景（时节、时候）
entries.en: time, season; the present time

entries.zh: 燮理阴阳（调和阴阳，使风调雨顺）；调燮时令
entries.en: to temper the seasons; to harmonize yin and yang (so as to bring mild, timely weather)
entries.notes: H 栏首字带 [疑:燮/癉] 且两处声调污损；M 音与“燮理阴阳”成语全合，仍取燮理义

entries.zh: 好天气，好时节（正相宜之时）
entries.en: fine weather; a favourable, suitable season

entries.zh: 可还（可归还；到期该还之时）
entries.en: repayable, due to be paid back; the time of repayment
entries.notes: L 栏西语残句（…pagan＝届时支付）与 H/M“可还”相合；M 首字声调污损

entries.zh: 定时，固定或约定的时刻
entries.en: a fixed, appointed time

entries.zh: 霜降（二十四节气之一，始降霜之期）
entries.en: Frost Descent (solar term of late October, when frost begins to fall)
entries.notes: L 栏 yela 依 17 世纪正字法当为 hiela（下霜），与霜降相合；M 首字声调污损

entries.zh: 霜寒雪冻（下霜结冻的时节）
entries.en: frost season, when frost, cold and snow congeal
entries.notes: M 栏首字声调污损；余三字与 tiempo de yelos 相合

entries.zh: 正及时，恰好赶上时候
entries.en: just in time, right on season
entries.notes: M 栏前两字声调均污损；义同第 1 条 a buen tiempo，取“正及时”

entries.zh: 着时，恰逢其时（赶得巧）
entries.en: timely, hitting the right moment; in season

entries.zh: 合时，合乎时宜
entries.en: seasonable, fitting the time
entries.notes: M 栏“合”字声调污损；义取“合时”

entries.zh: 赴时，赴日（如期赴约，依时而行）
entries.en: to keep the appointed time or day; to go in good time
entries.notes: M 栏“日”字声调污损；第二读当作“赴日”，即如期赴约

entries.zh: 一任（任凭；一个任期）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: one term; at one's pleasure 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: L 词头带 [疑:invierno/registro]，与 H/M“一任”不合；两字声调均污损，语义无法定夺

entries.zh: 店，店铺
entries.en: shop, store; stall

entries.zh: 铺，铺子（商肆）
entries.en: shop, store

entries.zh: 坎〔与西语词头 tienda 对应不明，原件污损，释义存疑〕
entries.en: kan, a pit or hollow 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: L“numeral”标记与 H“坎”（坑穴）对应不明，声调亦污损，语义无法定夺

entries.zh: 铺舍（营房、宿舍；铺兵驻守之所）
entries.en: quarters, barracks; lodging, tent

entries.zh: 坎店（店铺之称）
entries.en: shop, covered stall (local commercial term)

entries.zh: 店家（店主；开店铺之家）
entries.en: shopkeeper; shop-house
entries.notes: M 栏“家”字声调污损；义取“店家”

entries.zh: 慎（谨慎、稳重、小心）
entries.en: prudent, cautious; moderate, modest, careful
entries.notes: L 词头后半残损（fenertienn 难辨），但所附西语释义 moderado/modesto/cuidadoso 与“慎”全合；M 声调污损
